title: Data Analyst Intern
description:
Job Type: Internship (3-6 Months) Experience Level: Entry Level / Student

About the Internship
We are looking for a curious and detail-oriented Data Analyst Intern to join our Data team. This internship is designed to give you real-world experience in the full data lifecycle—from data extraction and cleaning to visualization and insight generation. You will work closely with senior analysts and business stakeholders to help solve actual business problems and support data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
Data Cleaning & Preparation: Assist in collecting, cleaning, and organizing raw data from various sources to ensure accuracy and readiness for analysis.

Dashboarding: Help design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Looker to track key performance indicators (KPIs).

Ad-Hoc Analysis: Support the team by running SQL queries to answer specific business questions and investigate data anomalies.

Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate manual data reporting processes (e.g., replacing manual Excel work with automated scripts).

Presentation: Prepare summary reports and presentations to communicate your findings to the team.

Qualifications
Education: Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

Excel/Google Sheets: Advanced proficiency (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Index-Match, Conditional Formatting).

SQL: Basic to Intermediate knowledge of SQL (ability to write SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY queries).

Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to ask the "why" behind the numbers.

Communication: Ability to communicate findings clearly, both verbally and in writing.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
Familiarity with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Google Looker Studio).

Basic understanding of Python or R for data analysis (Pandas, Matplotlib).

Previous internship experience or academic projects involving real-world datasets.

What You Will Learn
Technical Skills: Deepen your knowledge of SQL, data warehousing concepts, and enterprise-grade BI tools.

Business Acumen: Understand how data translates into business strategy and operational efficiency.

Collaboration: Experience working in an Agile environment with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product, Sales).

Mentorship: You will be paired with a mentor who will guide your professional development throughout the internship.

Tech Stack You Will Encounter
Tools: Excel, Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Keynote

Database: SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL / BigQuery)

Visualization: Power BI / Tableau / Looker
